$comment: Suri's mill race (Q0.6, optional): turn the channel tiles until the water from the spring reaches both outlets. The grid is the game's; what the spring, the wheel and the check gate stand for (for the Copilot app course: the fork's GitHub Actions, the practice checks running, and the check that fails on purpose) is this file's.

text.turn: Turn the channel · Shift+E turns back
text.enabledCrane: Workflows enabled. Now run the setup script at the crane.
text.enabledTurn: Workflows enabled. Now turn the channels (E, or Shift+E to turn back) until the water reaches both outlets.
text.finishWithSuri: Talk to Suri to finish up at the mill.
text.hintGate1: Read the sign over the gate, Captain. That’s the Actions tab talking.
text.hintGate2: The lever by the basin: “I understand my workflows, go ahead and enable them.”
text.hintGate3Crane: I’ve pulled it for you. Workflows are on, so back to the crane!
text.hintGate3: I’ve pulled it for you. Workflows are on.
text.hintFlow1: Follow the water from the spring. Does it reach both outlets?
text.hintFlow2Back: That glowing tile is where the water stops. Shift+E turns it back the short way.
text.hintFlow2: That glowing tile is where the water stops. Turn it until the channel lines up.
